messages:
morgan_cs: Kicking off Aurelium onboarding — quick sync re: stakeholders, success criteria, and 30/60 timeline. @samir_aurelium can you confirm the primary technical contact and preferred weekly cadence?

samir_aurelium: Hey! Thanks Morgan. Primary contact will be me (Samir). Weekly 30-min sync on Tuesdays works. PM is Priya (cc'd via email).

alex_se: Noted. I'll need the VPC CIDR and whether they'll use our shared infra or a dedicated VPC for dev/prod. Also any expected peak QPS for tokenization endpoints?

morgan_cs: Good Qs. Samir — can you paste the CIDR and expected peak qps? If unknown, a conservative 100 qps for initial planning is fine.

samir_aurelium: CIDR: 10.18.0.0/16. For now target 75 qps, spike to 200 during demo periods. We'll confirm Prod numbers in 2 weeks.

jamie_onboarding: I'll own enablement. Proposed quick wins: 1) Scripted prompt library import, 2) Two 1-hr enablement sessions (dev + product), 3) Health dashboard access. Can we schedule sessions week of 5/12?

luis_enable: +1 on dashboard access. Need list of 3 example prompts and one failing case for regression alerts.

morgan_cs: Success criteria I'm proposing (tentative):
- Integrations: basic inference working from Aurelium app to Redwood hosted model via API auth
- Latency: p95 < 600ms on dev traffic
- Reliability: no more than 1 incident impacting >10% of requests in 30d
- Enablement: 2 sessions completed and internal devs can reproduce sample prompts

ops-bot: Deployment checklist started by alex_se. Status: infra request created (#REQ-2241).

alex_se: Infra needs: dedicated subnet, IAM service account with token-rotation policy, and KMS key for embeddings at rest. I can provision dev infra by 5/9 if approvals come today.

samir_aurelium: Approvals given. Priya approved KMS and dev subnet earlier today.

morgan_cs: Timeline proposal:
- Week 0 (this week): infra + auth setup (alex_se)
- Week 1: API smoke tests + enablement session 1 (jamie_onboarding)
- Week 2: Model tuning / evals and second enablement session
- Week 4: Pilot go/no-go review with Aurelium leadership

jamie_onboarding: I'll send calendar invites after we lock Tuesday cadence. Also will share prework doc (short checklist) — should take devs ~30m.

luis_enable: I'll prepare the dashboard invite and add synthetic traffic generator for the p95 checks.

morgan_cs: Risks/notes: 1) Prod CIDR & SSO mapping still pending — Samir to confirm by 5/9, 2) Renewal uplift conversation only if pilot meets latency/cost thresholds.

samir_aurelium: Will confirm SSO/Prod CIDR by Friday 5/9. Thanks all! Excited to get started. :rocket:

morgan_cs: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the sync agenda + shared confluence link shortly. @ops-bot can you create a tracker ticket for the 30/60 timeline?

ops-bot: Tracker ticket created: CS-1127 (Aurelium onboarding — 30/60)

morgan_cs: Closing loop for now. If anything urgent ping me directly.
